messages.subject: does geom_errorbar stop working?
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to generate a plot using geom_errorbar but nothing comes
out, the strange thing is that the very same code was working last
week. I tried re-installing ggplot2 with no success. This code creates
an empty plot for me:

dat <- data.frame(x=1:2, y=1:6, g=LETTERS[1:3], e=.5)
pos <- position_dodge(.2)
lim <- aes(ymin=y-e, ymax=y+e)

ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=g)) + geom_point(position=pos) +
geom_errorbar(lim, position=pos, width=.1)

This is my system configuration:
R version 2.14.1 (2011-12-22)
Platform: i386-apple-darwin9.8.0/i386 (32-bit)

locale:

Can anybody suggest a workaround?

Thanks!
